column1: # FKS1 (echinocandin) concordance truth set -- 100 WGS C. auris isolates.
# Truth = PMC12323592 (Misas et al., "A benchmark dataset for validating FKS1 mutations in
#   Candida auris", Microbiol Spectr 2025; doi:10.1128/spectrum.03147-24). US-Gov public domain.
# The pre-registered external benchmark for scripts/validate_fks1_concordance.py
#   (prereg work/PREREGISTRATION_fks1_concordance.md, sha da8e3827...). This fixture's own
#   SHA-256 is pinned in work/PREREG_fks1_concordance.sha256 and re-checked by the grader.
# PROVENANCE (2026-09-10). The paper IS open-access (an earlier note that it was paywalled/
#   CAPTCHA-gated was wrong): Table 1 was extracted verbatim from the PMC HTML
# FIDELITY CHECK: the paper's per-isolate (S)/(R) column is reproduced 100/100 by the paper's
#   own stated rule (CAS>=2 OR ANID>=4 OR MICA>=4 -> R). susceptibility below is that column.
# ENA VERIFICATION: all 99 distinct run accessions confirmed live against the ENA read_run API
#   orchestration aligns with `minimap2 -ax sr`; a non-Illumina run would misalign.
# expected_panel: the HS1 panel token(s) {S639F,S639P,S639Y} the caller must emit for this
#   isolate, '-' if none. ONLY S639F/P/Y are caller-panel tokens; other FKS1 changes
#   (D642Y, F635Y/C hs1; W691L/C, M690I hs3; R1354S hs2) are reported verbatim but NOT panel
#   tokens -- they are the C2 marker-coverage ceiling and read as resistance-detection misses,
#   by design. The verbatim paper mutation for every isolate is kept in `note` (paper_mut=...).
# susceptibility: 'R'/'S' echinocandin phenotype anchor (the paper interpretation column).
# DECISION D1 (truth for de-novo-reclassified isolates): where the paper's reference pipeline
#   read 'Undetermined' but a footnote gives a de-novo genotype, the de-novo genotype is truth.
#   => B21247 expected_panel=S639F (footnote c). B19896 = F635C (footnote a; non-panel -> '-').
#   B21978 empty-cell = M690I outside the detection region (footnote b; non-panel -> '-').
# DECISION D2 (duplicated accession): SRR21675882 is listed by the paper against TWO isolates
#   with opposite phenotypes (B15223 Clade IV S639P/R; B16328 Clade III wild-type/S) -- a
#   genuine source defect. Both are KEPT for the record as '#'-commented rows at the end and
#   are EXCLUDED from scoring (98 isolates scored). Do not uncomment without resolving the
#   accession collision against the paper's supplement.
# Columns (tab-separated; '#'-comment lines are skipped by the grader):
